data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were $755.05m (per balance sheet). The report does not provide an explicit single-line gross prioryear movement (gross PYD) in the notes; total gross claims outstanding reduced during the year (closing gross claims outstanding $618.18m) and the 'movement in provision' line shows a gross decrease in claims provisions during 2023 of $141.701m (this is a movement in the full year and includes current-year development as well as prioryear runoff). No explicit gross prioryear only movement is disclosed in a single labelled note, so a gross PYD figure could not be reliably extracted from the available disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: higher frequency or severity of claims experience (claims risk)
inadequate or insufficient loss reserving (reserving risk)

Claims incurred represent the cost of claims and settlement expenses paid during the financial year, together with the movement in provisions for outstanding claims and claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) at 1 Jan 2023: $755,050k -> 755.05m USD. The report does not present an explicit labelled 'gross prior-year development' line. The technical reserves reconciliation includes a 'movement in provision' for gross claims of -141,701 ($'000) for 2023, but that movement is the total year movement (combines current-year development and prior-year run-off) and therefore was not used as the authoritative prior-year-only movement per the extraction rules. A gross claims development triangle exists in the notes but its tabular layout in the provided extract made reliable automated diagonal comparison difficult; therefore a gross PYD was not calculated from the triangle. All amounts in this JSON are in the native report currency (USD) and expressed in millions. Prior-year development is returned null due to lack of an explicit gross PYD figure in the disclosed notes or a reliably parseable triangle in the provided pages.
